subject: HealthAlign security & IAM follow-up — SOC2, SSO/SCIM evidence, vendor questionnaire
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@healthalign.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + initial IAM evidence request

Hi Daniel — thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned as you evaluate Redwood for inference across your patient-facing analytics workloads.

Summary of call:
- HealthAlign goals: reduce token costs while keeping sub-200ms p50 latency for short prompts; maintain strict PHI controls for clinical notes ingestion.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 status & coverage, HIPAA/GDPR applicability, SSO/SAML integration, downstream provisioning (SCIM), RBAC for admin vs. app users, export & retention controls.

Immediate asks (what would unblock your security review):
1) SOC 2 report (Type II) or SOC 2 readiness statement + planned audit date.
2) Short answers on HIPAA/GDPR coverage and whether Redwood is willing to sign a BAA / DPA (high level ok for now).
3) Kick off of your vendor security questionnaire — I attached our "redwood-iam-evidence-checklist.xlsx" which maps to the typical HealthAlign questionnaire items for IAM (SSO, SAML metadata, SCIM endpoints, RBAC matrix).
4) Technical details we can provide quickly: SAML metadata (IdP/SP XML), SCIM v2 endpoints + sample provisioning payloads, admin role definitions and default permissions.

Proposal / timeline:
- By EOD Tue (2026-06-22): we share SOC 2 summary and BAA template + SAML metadata stub for quick smoke test.
- By Fri (2026-06-26): submit completed vendor questionnaire answers (or the parts you want first), plus SCIM docs and a suggested RBAC matrix.

Rishi & Monica — can you confirm the SOC 2 artifact we have is the high-level summary + auditor name, and whether we can hand over SAML metadata and a SCIM example by Monday?

Daniel — if that timeline works, I can also lock a 30-min follow-up for next week to walk through the RBAC matrix with your security architect. If you prefer, send the vendor questionnaire now and we’ll start filling the answers in parallel.

Attachment: redwood-iam-evidence-checklist.xlsx (12KB)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@healthalign.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@healthalign.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + initial IAM evidence request

Vanessa — great summary, appreciate the clear asks. A couple quick clarifications from our side and an initial attachment:

1) Procurement asked me to send our vendor security questionnaire; attaching the PDF (HealthAlign_Vendor_Security_Q_June2026.pdf). We typically like to see SOC 2 Type II but can accept a SOC 2 Type I with a planned Type II audit date for early pilots.
2) HIPAA: for pilot we will be in-scope because some datasets include PHI fields. We need a signed BAA before production access.
3) For SSO we use a mix of Okta and Azure AD; SAML metadata will be our starting point. SCIM provisioning is preferred but not required for the pilot — we can manage users manually if RBAC is enforced.

Immediate asks back to Redwood:
- Confirm BAA/DPA process and share a draft if available.
- Provide SAML SP metadata or an IdP integration doc so our security team can review.
- Fill the attached questionnaire in whatever order is easiest — we prioritize sections: (a) IAM, (b) Data Protection, (c) Logging & Audit.

I've attached the questionnaire and will loop in our security engineer (TBD) once we have the SOC/BAA artifacts. Tentative timeline: procurement wants completed vendor review within 2 weeks if possible.

Attachment: HealthAlign_Vendor_Security_Q_June2026.pdf (230KB)

Thanks,
Daniel Cho
Security Program Manager | HealthAlign
daniel.cho@healthalign.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@healthalign.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + initial IAM evidence request

Thanks Vanessa / Daniel — quick technical notes from my side:

- We can provide SAML SP metadata immediately (XML) and a sample Okta integration guide; I will attach the metadata stub to the next email.
- SCIM: we support SCIM v2 with OAuth 2.0 bearer token; provisioning endpoints support create/update/delete for users and group syncing. I can send a sample request/response (JSON) and rate limits.
- RBAC: default roles are: reader (app-level read), writer (create content), admin (org-level config + billing), and support (limited logs access). We can provide a customizable RBAC matrix mapping to HealthAlign roles.

Monica — can you confirm who on CS should lead the RBAC workshop if HealthAlign asks for a short technical session? I'm happy to be on the call for the IdP/SCIM walkthrough.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + initial IAM evidence request

Daniel / Procurement — following up with concrete next steps and a short timeline:

1) Today: I will upload our SOC 2 summary + BAA draft to the secure link below. Expect an email with access.
2) Monday (2026-06-22): Rishi will share SAML SP metadata and SCIM sample payloads; we will also start populating the IAM section of your questionnaire and share a working doc for you to review.
3) Wed (2026-06-24): propose a 30-min technical walkthrough (Rishi + Monica) for SSO/SCIM + RBAC mapping. Please send preferred times.
4) Fri (2026-06-26): target to submit all answered sections for initial procurement review; any items requiring signatures (BAA) we can route to legal in parallel.

Secure links: https://redwood.app/s/HLGN-4821/qa (SOC 2 summary & BAA draft will be posted here)
Shared working doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ABCxyz-iam-template

If that schedule is too aggressive, tell me which milestones to move and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to progressing — happy to set the Wed walkthrough now if you confirm times.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
